known_assets: Map 1 still derives its materials from the existing Wikimedia Commons wall/floor/stone sources in visuals/spaces-lab/index.html.
Map 1 v22 floor uses one continuous corridor plane plus a single restrained floor material overlay instead of repeating the texture per Z band.
Map 4 reuses the existing warm re-grade of the stone image for wall/vault panels; its moving ribs and floor guides are procedural world geometry.
Map 5 giant hinged signs remain procedural physical props: long brown pole, large tan cardboard panel, dark backing edge and violet painted mark.
No new external image dependency was added in v22.
visuals/spaces-lab/assets/checker-grid.svg remains historical/optional and is not loaded by current runtime.
rule: Never let internal Z subdivisions become visible as accidental horizontal floor bands. Prefer continuous planes and world-anchored structural repetition.
